name: modbench
description: Modbench: install and order mods; view, edit, and compare Bethesda plugin files (.esp/.esm/.esl)

modbench.attachToBackendPort.description: Attach to an mEdit already running on this port instead of starting one. Never a fallback: if nothing answers, Modbench reports it. Leave unset: each window starts its own mEdit.

modbench.mods.gameDirectory.description: The game directory (the folder containing the game executable and Data/). A Steam install or a stock game folder. Leave blank to fall back to ModOrganizer.ini's gamePath, then Steam auto-detect.

enumDescriptions: The day the copy was last modified.
A letter for the contents of the copy: A is the master's, so two cells with the same letter hold the same file.
modbench.mods.conflictTable.cellValue.description: What each cell of a mod's conflict table shows of its copy.

modbench.mods.greyInactiveFiles.description: Grey a file the game does not get, in the Mods view and the Explorer: another copy wins its path, it is excluded, or its mod is disabled.

modbench.mods.indicators.overwritesLoose.description: Overwrites loose files: badge a mod's row in the Mods view when a file of the mod wins over another copy.
Overwrites loose files: colour a mod's name in the Mods view when a file of the mod wins over another copy.

modbench.mods.indicators.overwrittenLoos.description: Overwritten loose files: badge a mod's row in the Mods view when a file of the mod loses to another copy, and the mod is not Redundant.
Overwritten loose files: colour a mod's name in the Mods view when a file of the mod loses to another copy, and the mod is not Redundant.

modbench.mods.indicators.redundant.badge.description: Redundant: badge a mod's row in the Mods view when the mod has a file the game could get, and every such file loses to another copy.

modbench.mods.indicators.redundant.colou.description: Redundant: colour a mod's name in the Mods view when the mod has a file the game could get, and every such file loses to another copy.

modbench.mods.indicators.containsExclude.description: Contains excluded files: badge a mod's row in the Mods view when the mod has an excluded file.
Contains excluded files: colour a mod's name in the Mods view when the mod has an excluded file.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run build && npm run build:backend
scripts.build: tsc -b && node esbuild.mjs && npm run build:webview
scripts.test:integration: tsc -p tsconfig.integration.json && env -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY -u XDG_SESSION_TYPE xvfb-run -a vscode-test
